findings: A nodular pancreatic cancer measuring 18 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. No local invasion factors are identified. There are no findings suggestive of lymph node metastasis. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:

Task 3: Regional lymph nodes for the body of the pancreas are: 8a, 8p, 9, 10, 11p, 11d, 14t, 18. Since there are no findings suggestive of lymph node metastasis, the N classification is N0.

Task 6: Stage IA (T1c, N0, M0)
